maddeler.e:
استوضحا (form X)
# اِسْتَوْضَحَا (istawḍaḥā) /is.taw.dˤa.ħaː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِسْتَوْضَحَ (istawḍaḥa)
# اُسْتُوضِحَا (ustūḍiḥā) /us.tuː.dˤi.ħaː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِسْتَوْضَحَ (istawḍaḥa)
# اِسْتَوْضِحَا (istawḍiḥā) /is.taw.dˤi.ħaː/: second-person dual imperative of اِسْتَوْضَحَ (istawḍaḥa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
